summary: Frontend-only re-test of the atomic New Lead workflow (SECURITY DEFINER RPC create_lead_with_customer). All 5 scenarios PASS on the live preview after clearing a corrupt /app/frontend/.next dev-server cache. (A) Happy path: /rest/v1/rpc/create_lead_with_customer returns 200 with {customer_id, lead_id}, the 'ATOMIC Test-0722b' row appears at the top with status NEW, and the success toast 'Lead created.' (data-testid=toast-success) is shown. (B) Detail drawer for the new lead shows the entered name 'ATOMIC Test-0722b', email 'atomic.test@example.com' AND phone '5045550300' — confirming lead.customer_id links to the newly created customer. (C) After full page reload, ATOMIC Test-0722b is still at lead-row-0 with status NEW. (D) With three physical Playwright clicks on submit-new-lead in quick succession, exactly ONE 'DUPEB Guard-0722c' row and ONE RPC call were observed — the async 'if (saving) return' + loading-disabled guard works under realistic user click cadence. (E) Empty first/last name submission shows the exact expected error toast 'Customer first and last name are required.' (data-testid=toast-error), drawer stays open, and no new lead is created (row count unchanged pre/post).
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate-guard is soft: `if (saving) return` in submit() is React-state based, so purely-synchronous invocations that fire faster than a React render tick can bypass it. In this run, page.evaluate(() => { btn.click(); btn.click(); btn.click(); }) resulted in 3 RPC calls and 3 'DUPE Guard-0722' rows because React had no chance to re-render `saving=true` and set the button disabled between calls. Real physical/mouse clicks (Playwright .click() ×3) all funneled to a single RPC call because the browser event loop yielded between clicks and React re-rendered `disabled`. Realistic UX is safe, but for full robustness consider a useRef guard (savingRef.current = true set synchronously at the top of submit) in addition to the existing state guard.

Drawer child DOM (lead-first-name input) remains mounted after showNew=false — not a bug, but tests that use query_selector to check 'drawer closed' should instead assert visibility or a visible child. Not blocking.

Dev-server .next cache was corrupted (Cannot find module './592.js' / './638.js' for /login and /dashboard chunks, causing 404 on /_next/static/chunks/app/login/page.js and main-app.js, which broke React hydration on the /login page). Testing agent cleared /app/frontend/.next and restarted supervisor frontend; login+hydration then worked. If this recurs after main-agent edits, main agent should `rm -rf /app/frontend/.next && sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`.

Toaster is a custom in-house component (data-testid=`toast-success`|`toast-error`|`toast-info`), NOT sonner as noted in the review request. Any future selectors should target [data-testid^='toast-'] rather than sonner attributes.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 acceptance scenarios pass — A: RPC 200 + row at top + success toast; B: customer email+phone visible in detail drawer; C: persists after reload; D: physical rapid clicks produce exactly 1 lead; E: exact validation toast + no lead created)

seed_data_creation: Created via the UI on live preview and left in place per instructions (user cleans via SQL): ATOMIC Test-0722b (customer_id 49247b5c-1181-499f-a8b0-392f8c5e9557 / lead_id 7498c13b-dd5b-4ce3-aff0-1b570c3f7dc9, source rpc-test, 750 cu ft, 3 bedrooms, Feb 15 2026, origin 10 Atomic Rd New Orleans / destination 20 RPC Blvd Kenner); ATOMIC2 ToastCheck-0722 (secondary happy-path lead for toast capture); DUPEB Guard-0722c (single lead from 3 rapid physical clicks — proves guard works); 3× DUPE Guard-0722 (from an initial synchronous JS click test that bypasses React's render tick — safe to delete, see soft-guard comment).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Atomic New Lead workflow (create_lead_with_customer RPC) is verified end-to-end from the qa-owner UI session. RPC returns {customer_id, lead_id}; customer link is visible in the lead detail drawer (email+phone). Duplicate guard holds for real user clicks but is theoretically bypassable via synchronous JS click bursts — flagged for main-agent as an optional hardening (useRef). Custom toast component (not sonner) uses data-testid=toast-{success|error|info}. If /login stops hydrating and _next/static/chunks/*.js return 404 with 'Cannot find module' in /var/log/supervisor/frontend.err.log, clear /app/frontend/.next and restart supervisor frontend.
rca of the issue: Blocker encountered mid-run: Next.js dev-server webpack cache was corrupt — /app/frontend/.next/server/webpack-runtime.js could not require './592.js'/'./638.js', so /login and /dashboard pages 404'd their client chunks (/_next/static/chunks/app/login/page.js, /main-app.js). Result: React never hydrated, form onSubmit handler never attached, submit-button click caused native GET to /login? with empty query and blank state (matches screenshots). Reproduction: tail /var/log/supervisor/frontend.err.log — 'Cannot find module ./NNN.js Require stack: .next/server/webpack-runtime.js'. Mitigation applied: `rm -rf /app/frontend/.next && sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`, dev server recompiled cleanly (Ready in 1289ms, /login 200), hydration confirmed by clicking data-testid=switch-to-signup and observing h1 change from 'Welcome back' to 'Create your account'. All 5 acceptance scenarios then passed.
